service.description: Sales' setup readiness, answering the framework's readiness contract (moqui.server.ReadinessProvider sales.readiness) with no adapter: called with providerKey and an organizationPartyId (or none, for each organization of the caller's scope that uses Sales: a pipeline, a team, a lead source offered or an opportunity of its own), returns checks of checkKey, title, state (ready, warning, failed or unavailable), reasonCode, message, the organization as subject and scope, and for a check that is not ready its owner's place as a route key (fixRoute, with fixId where it names a record): a default pipeline (salesStages), a pipeline in effect without stages (salesStages, the pipeline), a team with a member (salesTeams) and a lead source offered (salesLeadSources). Later phases add theirs. One check that fails is unavailable by name and the others go on. Changes nothing. Refuses a caller without SALES_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an organization outside their scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).
